text:
Jordan: Heads-up — product is repacking pricing packs next quarter (moving several Starter users to higher default quotas). Need a quick demand-sensitivity sketch for GPU capacity and an ask recommendation. @Maria @Chen
Maria: got it. what's the baseline numbers you're using? monthly and regional split?
Jordan: baseline we use for infra planning: ~3,200 A100-equivalent GPU-hrs/day (~96k/mo). regional split: us 62%, eu 28%, apac 10%. Starter pool active users ~4.5k.
Chen: quick assumptions check: if 12% of Starter converts to higher quota and per-customer qps rises 2x after conversion, rough uplift ~= +28% GPU-hours (so ~4.1k hrs/day, ~123k/mo). if conversion *and* onboarding promo increases qps 3x during first 2 weeks, short-term burst could be ~2.1x baseline (~6.7k hrs/day).
Ali: rough cost arithmetic: our blended marginal infra cost ~ $2.80 / A100-hr (reserved + spot mix). So delta for +28% (~27k extra hrs/mo) ≈ $75.6k/mo. Worst-case burst delta (~105k extra hrs/mo) ≈ $294k/mo. I'll confirm with finance but good to have these placeholders.
ops-bot: daily-summary: last_30d_avg_gpu_hours=3200, p95_24h=5400, active_starter=4500, dedicated_headroom_available=480 GPUs across regions.
Kai: flag: APAC Dedicated headroom in asia-south1 is limited this quarter (we only have ~150 GPUs free to spin in region). If adoption skews APAC we either need cross-region routing OR temporary cloud marketplace bursts. Cross-region will add latency for some customers.
Maria: mitigations to consider (short list):
- Reserve a small burst pool (dedicated) ~200 A100-eq for 6 weeks around rollout.
- Autoscale policy: increase max instances for Starter->Pro routes by 35% and enable faster scale-up throttle window.
- Temporary uplift throttles: add soft-rate-limits for new tenants for first 14 days.
- Model fallback: route to 8-bit quantized variants when queue depth > 200 reqs.
- Sales/Finance: consider short-term capacity commit to get lower blended $/hr.
Jordan: for routing policy we could do something like:
```
route_policy {
  prefer_region: customer_region
  fallback_order: [same_region_spot, us_burst_pool, eu_burst_pool]
  throttle: {per_tenant_first_14d: 25req/min}
}
```
Chen: I can run 3 sims: conservative (+12% total), expected (+28%), and aggressive (+110% short burst for 2 weeks). Will need last 90 days of per-tenant qps hist + new-tenant signup forecast. Give me access to the "starter-metrics" logs.
Ali: I'll prep a quick cost table and run it against finance rate card. Can we target 48h turnaround?
Maria: owners: Chen -> demand sims (48h), Ali -> cost table & finance check (48h), Kai -> validate APAC headroom + cross-region latency impact (72h), Jordan -> coordinate canary timing with product. I'll open an internal ticket. :white_check_mark:
Jordan: plan for a canary rollout (10% of Starter) for 2 weeks, monitor GPU usage, p95 latency, and error rates. If canary < +10% uplift we roll; if 10-30% then use burst pool; if >30% halt and engage execs.
usage-bot: note: enroll canary tag `pricing-repack-canary` for metrics pipeline.
Maria: also tag telemetry so we can break down uplift by cohort, region, model-size, and prompt-type. Need dashboards: gpu-hours/tenant, queue-depth, model-fallback-rate.
Jordan: perfect. please paste sims and cost table back into this thread when ready. We'll review at weekly capacity sync.
Chen: starting sims now. asking for logs perms.
Ali: pinging finance for rate card, will link results here.
Kai: noted. will validate APAC options and add a short runbook for cross-region routing fallback.
Jordan: thanks all — appreciate the quick turnaround. :eyes:
